content: However, these platforms generally do not offer segmentation by industry, meaning that dedicated expertise in the mining and IT sectors requires further vetting [90][92] . Furthermore, industry directories such as Clutch.co highlight reputable SEO service providers operating in the region, including Ruby Digital, Woww, and ROAST [94] . A curated list from MO Agency also identifies various agencies operating specifically within Johannesburg, a major economic hub adjacent to significant mining operations [91] . While these sources confirm the general availability of SEO services, they lack direct mentions of specialized expertise in the mining or IT industries, suggesting that generalist agencies may not fully grasp the nuanced technical requirements of mining IT solutions [91][94] .
